info.title: YTA BFF API
info.description: Browser-facing API. Internal Alpha, database and Hermes credentials are never accepted from clients. JSON bodies are limited to 32 KiB after decompression. Zod normalization and cross-field refinements remain authoritative. Historical fact payloads are versioned and partially open in this document.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: If supplied, must equal body.request_id. Reuse that identity after response loss; never resend unknown execution under a new key.

429.description: RESEARCH_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: the authenticated owner's rolling 24-hour admission quota for this data mode is exhausted. No new Run or upstream execution is created. Existing same-key requests still return their original Run; failures, cancellations and unknown executions do not refund quota. This is a request-count limit, not a token or currency budget. Do not automatically retry with a new key.

200.description: SSE id is event_id, event is type, data is one agent event JSON object. Retry hint 1500 ms; comment heartbeats are not events. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID; no automatic resubmission. Terminal runs close the stream; disconnect or expired auth also closes it. A failure after headers closes the stream without a JSON error. Maximum four streams per owner per BFF process.
